headline: Apple challenges OpenAI’s forensic analysis in trade secrets case, seeks hardware R&D access
summary: Apple is demanding its own experts review forensic images used by OpenAI and other defendants. This move aims to ensure accuracy and transparency in the ongoing trade secrets dispute.
details: Apple has formally challenged the forensic analysis presented by OpenAI and other defendants in their ongoing trade secrets lawsuit. The tech giant is seeking permission for its own experts to review the forensic images used as evidence.

This request is part of Apple's broader strategy to gain access to the defendants' hardware R&D. The company believes this access is crucial for a thorough and independent evaluation of the alleged trade secret violations.

The move underscores the high stakes involved in the case, as both companies grapple over intellectual property. Independent verification of forensic data could significantly influence the outcome of the legal proceedings.
caption:

The move underscores the high stakes involved in the case, as both companies grapple over intellectual property. Independent verification of forensic data could significantly influence the outcome of the legal proceedings.

headline_marked: [[Robin Williams' daughter Zelda calls for end]] to AI-generated videos of her late father, citing 'shame'
headline: Robin Williams' daughter Zelda calls for end to AI-generated videos of her late father, citing 'shame'
summary: Zelda Williams has again urged fans to stop creating and sharing AI videos of Robin Williams, calling a recent "private video" clearly AI and unconvincing. She emphasizes that her father is not a "puppet."
details: Zelda Williams has publicly reiterated her plea for fans to cease creating and circulating AI-generated videos of her late father, Robin Williams. Her statement on X specifically addressed a "supposedly 'private video'" that she identified as "clearly AI."

She criticized the quality of the AI, stating that the voice was "robotic and terrible," and urged anyone believing it to have listened to his movies on mute. Williams called on creators to "leave him out of your delusional bullshit and let him rest."

This is not the first time Zelda has spoken out against such content. In October 2025, she posted on Instagram asking fans to stop sending her AI videos of her dad, emphasizing she doesn't want to see them.

Just last month, Zelda, along with her siblings Zak and Cody, revived Robin Williams' Instagram account. This action was taken in an attempt to "fight back against rampant AI abuse of his voice and likeness."
